$description: Shared design tokens of HUB BRO (web) and the bot's manager app (Flet). Single source: edit here, then run `node data/design/build.mjs`. Names follow the CSS custom properties of hub-bro/web/src/shared/styles/tokens.css (without the leading --). Keys starting with $ are notes and are not emitted.

surface.$note: Page background, cards, the label-paper preview and the dialog overlay.

text-secondary.$note: Do not go lighter: it disappears on --bg.

accent.$note: HUB BRO has no coloured accent: buttons, selected nav items and selected chips are black with white text.

border.$note: HUB BRO defines no border tokens: cards have no borders or shadows; inputs show a 2px --text border only on focus.

status.$note: Muted tones for the beige background. A status is always label + icon + colour. Text contrast >= 4.5:1 (WCAG AA).

stock.$note: Bright stock-count digits on the black warehouse size chips.

stock-zero.comment: Цифры остатка на чёрных чипах склада

stockLevels.$note: Which stock colour a count gets (hub-bro/web/src/shared/stock): 0 -> stock-zero (struck through), <= low -> stock-low, <= mid -> stock-mid, above -> stock-ok.

statusTone.$note: Reference copy of which tone each status uses in the hub (source of truth: hub-bro/web/src/shared/orders/statuses.ts and shared/stock/stock.ts). Tones: danger, success, warning, neutral.

font.$note: The hub loads Onest from Google Fonts via <link> in hub-bro/web/index.html (webCssUrl, weights 400/500/600). Flet's page.fonts needs a font FILE, not a CSS URL, so the manager app loads the same Google Fonts family as a TTF (fletFontUrl, variable font from the google/fonts repo) at runtime.

mono.$note: Manager app only (template editor, size grid). The hub has no monospace font; it uses tabular-nums for numbers.

size.$note: px sizes used across hub CSS modules, by role.

weight.$note: Only 400/500/600 are loaded from Google Fonts; a few 700s in CSS render as synthetic bold.

radiusExtra.$note: Not CSS variables in the hub (hard-coded in modules); listed for reuse.

shadow.$note: None: HUB BRO cards and buttons have no shadows (only focus rings drawn with box-shadow in modules).

$dark: HUB BRO is light only (docs/DESIGN.md: «тёмную пока не делаем»). No dark values are defined; the manager app runs ThemeMode.LIGHT.
